engine_proposal: Owner-selected pinned maintained encrypted content-addressed engine; restic is a researched candidate, not installed or approved here.
layout_proposal: encrypted-repository/ (engine-managed content-addressed encrypted packs, snapshots, indexes)
catalog manifests included inside exact encrypted snapshots, mapping original relative path + SHA256 + size + mode + epoch/source/toolchain/consumer provenance to snapshot path
sanitized in-repo relocation receipt with exact repository identity, full snapshot ID, encrypted-catalog digest, cohort totals and restore-receipt hash; no plaintext sensitive bodies/keys
identity: Whole-file plaintext SHA256+size catalog is independent of engine chunk/pack identifiers; equal bytes can share stored content while preserving every original path/epoch record.

access.operators: Named evidence custodian and independently authorized restore verifier; proposed roles, no identities granted.
access.automation: Read-only resolver by explicit approved repository identity; no implicit global mount, restored executable discovery, current skill path or automatic network fallback.

encryption.metadata: Encrypt sensitive path/provenance catalog as well as payloads; sanitize repo-visible pointers.
encryption.key_management: Owner-approved credential manager/escrow with separately tested key recovery, never repo/log/command output.
encryption.backup: Verified second encrypted copy on an approved separate failure domain before removal of unique original objects. Same PRO-G40 destination alone is not that copy.

classes.rule: Only after actual content review; concise hashes/outcomes may remain in repo, preserve linked-object recovery.
Preserve source/license/toolchain provenance, false acceptance fields and tested fixture semantics; encrypted catalog and named access.
Default for unreviewed bodies including caches, raw logs, binaries, backups and archives. No public/cloud transfer until classification/access authority is established.
Requires an exact genuine regeneration receipt from frozen inputs and approved discard rationale; cache suffix alone is insufficient. First batch preserves bytes anyway.

retention.interim_rule_proposal: Retain every proposed archived object and original-path catalog; no automatic forget/prune/expiry while legal/incident/release holds and owner-approved class retention remain unresolved.
